subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Economic Order Quantity
description: A 60-second lesson on Economic Order Quantity.

hook.text: Order too often and shipping costs eat your profit. Order too much and storage costs do the same. There's a formula.

buildup.text: Economic order quantity (EOQ) calculates the ideal order size that minimizes total inventory costs.

discovery.text: It balances ordering costs (shipping, admin) against holding costs (storage, capital, spoilage).

twist.text: EOQ assumes constant demand and fixed costs—rarely true. It's a starting point, not a final answer.

climax.text: Despite its simplicity, EOQ has guided purchasing decisions since its invention in 1913. It still works.

punchline.text: The best order size isn't a guess. It's a calculation.
